title: Discovery of Dual FGFR4 and EGFR Inhibitors by Machine Learning and Biological Evaluation.
summary: SVM predictions nominated an in-house compound with measured inhibition of both kinases. Docking and dynamics are supporting analyses, not evidence of clinical efficacy.
organization: China Pharmaceutical University; State Key Laboratory of Natural Medicine

evidence.tested: SVM predictions nominated an in-house compound with measured inhibition of both kinases. Docking and dynamics are supporting analyses, not evidence of clinical efficacy.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Support-vector-machine activity models is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
